annotations.title: Set a property in the running game

description:
Set one property on a node in the RUNNING game (the live object, never the scene file) and read back whether it applied: move the player, set health, flip a flag. Then check with summer_game_probe.
Guide: summer_docs_read {"id":"tool/runtime-set"}

field.description: Optional sub-field to set instead of the whole value, e.g. 'x' on a Vector3 property.

instance.description: Game instance to address (default 'main' = the editor's embedded game).

path.description: ABSOLUTE runtime node path, e.g. '/root/Main/Player' (from summer_game_probe tree).

property.description: Property name, e.g. 'position', 'health', 'visible'. 'script' and 'owner' are refused.

value.description: New value. JSON scalars for primitives; Godot literal strings for math types ('Vector3(1, 2, 3)', 'Color(1, 0, 0, 1)', 'Vector2(10, 0)').

name: summer_runtime_set
